data.one_liner: Admob plugin that shows banner ads using native platform views.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to display AdMob banner, interstitial, and reward ads using native platform views on Android and iOS. Provides initialization and tracking authorization helpers.
use_when: You want to display AdMob banner, interstitial, or rewarded ads in a Flutter app.
You are maintaining an existing project that already relies on admob_flutter.
avoid_when: Starting a new project (the README suggests using the official google_mobile_ads package instead).
You need active plugin maintenance and updates.
strengths: Supports banner, interstitial, and reward ads.
Provides test device ID support and easy initialization.
weaknesses: Looking for maintainers; the repository is not actively kept up to date with new features.
Official recommendation is to use google_mobile_ads instead.
data.setup_notes: Requires AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist updates with AdMob App IDs, iOS App Tracking Transparency usage description, and minimum platform versions.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the official Google-recommended package for displaying AdMob ads in Flutter.
